title: MenuPage
description: A single digitized page of a Menu in the NYPL 'What's on the Menu?' dataset. Each MenuPage is a scanned image produced during digitization and is the surface on which MenuItem transcriptions are positioned. Corresponds to a row in MenuPage.csv.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for the menu page. Primary key referenced by MenuItem.menu_page_id.

menu_id.description: Foreign key to the parent Menu.id this page belongs to.

page_number.description: Ordinal position of this page within the menu.

image_id.description: NYPL Digital Collections image identifier for the scanned page image.

full_height.description: Full pixel height of the digitized page image, used to interpret MenuItem ypos coordinates.

full_width.description: Full pixel width of the digitized page image, used to interpret MenuItem xpos coordinates.

uuid.description: Stable UUID for the digitized page image asset.
